mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the forward return direction.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction is negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return direction is positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800 thousand units signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1800, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return direction is positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise for 2 consecutive months, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
